title: Existential Probability Thresholds for 2-CNF Formulas
description:
For a 2-CNF with existential x variables and uniform probabilistic y variables, the algorithm decides whether fixing x leaves at least a p fraction of satisfying assignments to y, and returns such an x-assignment on acceptance. Given the exact integer count threshold, formula processing takes O((1/p)^c times formula size) word operations for c = 1 + 2/log2(4/3) < 5.82. A separately encoded rational has its own exact preprocessing cost.

This answers the fixed-parameter linear-time question in Open Problem 3 of Shyan Akmal’s dissertation. Earlier methods imply ordinary fixed-parameter tractability with a polynomial formula factor. The proof is internally reviewed. The Python replay is computational corroboration.

Under human direction, ChatGPT Astra 6.2 (OpenAI) generated the discovery proof and its research packet. Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) assisted with earlier audits and manuscript preparation. OpenAI Codex performed the mathematical review and revised the paper. GPT-6.2 Sol assisted with literature searches and release preparation. DannyExperiments maintains the repository and is the preferred citation identity. No AI system is proposed as an author.
